# AI Extension Manager (aem)

Local-first CLI + agent skill that keeps skills, MCP servers and rules in sync
across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code Copilot and DSH.
Two-way sync with SHA-256 state tracking, per-target backups, and conflicts
that exit non-zero instead of overwriting. MIT, zero runtime dependencies.

## Install

- Skill (any agent that supports Agent Skills): `npx skills add Jack91124/ai-extension-manager`
- CLI: `pip install git+https://github.com/Jack91124/ai-extension-manager` (then `aem --help`)

## Where each tool keeps skills (generated from scripts/aem_core.py, 2026-11-22)

| Tool | Personal skills | Project skills | MCP config | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | ~/.claude/skills | .claude/skills | ~/.claude.json<br>.mcp.json | ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md<br>CLAUDE.md |
| OpenAI Codex | ~/.codex/skills<br>~/.agents/skills | .agents/skills<br>.codex/skills | ~/.codex/config.toml | ~/.codex/AGENTS.md<br>AGENTS.md |
| Gemini CLI | ~/.gemini/skills<br>~/.agents/skills | .gemini/skills<br>.agents/skills | ~/.gemini/settings.json | ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md<br>GEMINI.md |
| Cursor | ~/.cursor/skills | .cursor/skills | ~/.cursor/mcp.json<br>.cursor/mcp.json | ~/.cursor/rules<br>.cursor/rules |
| VS Code / GitHub Copilot | ~/.copilot/skills | .github/skills | ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json<br>.mcp.json | ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md<br>.github/copilot-instructions.md<br>AGENTS.md<br>.github/instructions |
| DSH | ~/.dsh/skills<br>~/.agents/skills | .dsh/skills<br>.agents/skills | via plugins | ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md<br>~/.agents/AGENTS.md |

## When to use it

- A skill exists in one tool and you want it in the others without clobbering edits.
- You edited a copy in another tool and want it back in the library without losing either side.
- You want an honest inventory of where each tool stores skills, rules and MCP config.
